name: shine-border
title: Shine Border
description: A thin animated border of gradient light that sweeps around a card's outline, here wrapping a login form in shifting lilac, pink and peach.
use: A card needs to stand out with a moving coloured edge without recolouring its contents.
avoid: Light backgrounds or many cards; the glow is subtle and the loop repeats forever.
a11y: It is a decorative overlay that already stops animating when reduced-motion is requested. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded login card with a heading, two outlined inputs and a light Sign in button. Around its perimeter runs a soft line of purple, pink and warm orange light, brightest near the corners and fading along the edges.
behaves: The light band travels steadily around the border, gliding through the corners and completing laps without a pause. The card content itself stays still.
customise: Set borderWidth, duration and shineColor (one colour or an array); it is an overlay, so content and rounded corners come from the parent card.
weight: light: A single absolutely positioned gradient layer animated by one CSS keyframe.
